passes.name: run-{{stamp}}
passes.summary: Add Double to the toy package with its test, run the gate, and open a pull request.

questions.text: Should the toy package gain a Double function?
background: The toy package has one function, Add. Double is a one-line function with a one-line test, and nothing else calls it.

causes.yes: The pass adds Double and its test, runs the gate, and opens a pull request that the timed check merges.
causes.no: The package stays as it is and the pass has nothing to build.

questions.reason: The change is tiny and the gate covers it.
